title: Cartridge Registry Listing 1
description: One listing document, served at https://cartridge.app/r/<name>.json. It never hosts cartridge bytes; it points at where they live and records what they are.

name.description: Listing key, either registry/<slug> (file r/<slug>.json) or <org-slug>/<slug> (file r/<org-slug>/<slug>.json). Each slug is [a-z0-9-], 1-64 chars, no leading or trailing hyphen.

title.description: Human title shown on the listing.

version.description: Listing version, dotted numeric (e.g. 2026.09). An existing name may only change when this increases.

license.description: SPDX id (or public-domain) from the registry allowlist. Anything else is refused; see POLICY.md.

source_url.description: Where the underlying source material came from.

warranty.description: The publisher asserts the right to distribute this content in this form. Must be true, and the PR body must carry the checked warranty checkbox.

description.description: Optional. One or two plain sentences about what the cartridge contains.

size_bytes.description: Size of the cartridge file in bytes. Hard cap 50 GiB.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA256 of the cartridge file bytes.

filename.description: The cartridge file name. Exactly one path component: no slashes.

urls.description: Where the bytes live, https only, mirrors tried in order. No host may be cartridge.app or a subdomain of it.

card.description: The full Card 1.0 object the presser embeds in the cartridge, copied verbatim.

published_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when this listing was published.

homepage.description: Optional. A page describing the cartridge.
